title: Figure 10. Sodium Chamber Negative Energy Separator; Figure 11 squeezed light generator
description: Figure 10 is a technical illustration of a cylindrical cavity with mirrors at each end, a wavy light path, a "LASER BEAM" crossing at an angle and a "SODIUM CHAMBER" box; caption: "Figure 10. Sodium Chamber Negative Energy Separator (Reference 41)". Figure 11, "Alternative Conceptual Squeezed Light Negative Energy Generator", shows three emitters producing groups of one, two and three photons converging through a lens into a combined beam.
